console-cleared.notes: Console renders bottom-left, clear of the 500dp panel. 'Clear' emptied the log (deterministic empty state); header shows 'Developer Console' with no error count. Toolbar: Clear/Problems/LuaUI Reload/LuaRules Reload/Cheating/Global LOS/GodMode/Popup on error/Hide (F8). 'Popup on error' and 'Global LOS' read pressed, which matches engine state (SB enables global LOS).

console-hidden.notes: F8 hides the console: the cropped region contains only the map, no console chrome at all. Confirms the plugin still receives key_press even though the engine feeds keys straight to its RmlUi contexts.

console-problems-off.notes: Problems un-pressed again; pixel-identical to console-cleared. The toggle is symmetric.

console-problems-on.notes: Identical to console-cleared except the 'Problems' button is now pressed (green). Proves the toggle round-trips through the manager and back into the DOM.

console-shown.notes: F8 brings the console back, identical to console-problems-off. Toggle is stable across hide/show.
